about.title: About the 151 set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: 151 is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 22 September 2023. It has 207 cards: 165 in the main set and 42 secret rares. For a master set there are also 153 reverse holos, and 19 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 165 main set cards), the Complete set (all 207 cards), the Master set (360 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (379 cards, adding the 19 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
